load_obj_file: load a wavefront OBJ file from a path and return vertices, texture coordinates, and face indices as numpy arrays
load_obj_with_normals: load a wavefront OBJ file with vertex normals included by setting return_vn to True
load_obj_from_io: load a wavefront OBJ file from a TextIO object instead of a file path string
parse_obj_vertices: parse vertex positions from a wavefront OBJ file and return them as an n-by-3 float32 numpy array
parse_obj_faces: parse face definitions from a wavefront OBJ file and return vertex indices and texture coordinate indices
